branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When liquidation exhausts borrower collateral, residual borrow shares/assets are removed and badDebtAssets reduces that market totalSupplyAssets. Vault adapter realAssets then carries supplier losses into share NAV; there is no guaranteed par redemption.
